MVCTBS.description: Moving Load Analysis Control - BS (MVCTBS). Controls how moving-load influence results are generated and which reactions/displacements/forces/links are calculated, optionally filtered by structure group.

iIGP.description: Influence generating points mode. When 0, UNUMT (number of points per line element) is used; when non-zero, DIST (distance between points) is used instead.

UNUMT.description: [iIGP=0] Number of influence-generating points per line element. Only applied when iIGP is 0.

DIST.description: [iIGP!=0] Distance between influence-generating points. Only applied when iIGP is non-zero.

PLATE.description: Analysis result position for plates (case-insensitive). CENTER = element center, NODAL = nodal positions.

bCONCURRENT.description: Calculate concurrent forces (Concurrent force check box).

bCSTRCALC.description: Calculate combined stresses for frames (Combined stress check box).

bRGP.description: Reaction filter scope. false = All, true = Group (limits reactions to the group named in RGP).

RGP.description: Reaction group name. Applied only when bREAC and bRGP are both true; the group must exist. Use empty string when All is selected.

bDGP.description: Displacement filter scope. false = All, true = Group (limits displacements to the group named in DGP).

DGP.description: Displacement group name. Applied only when bDISP and bDGP are both true; the group must exist. Use empty string when All is selected.

bFGP.description: Force/moment filter scope. false = All, true = Group (limits forces/moments to the group named in FGP).

FGP.description: Force/moment group name. Applied only when bFM and bFGP are both true; the group must exist. Use empty string when All is selected.

bLG.description: Link filter scope. false = All, true = Group (limits links to the boundary group named in LGP).

LGP.description: Link boundary group name. Applied only when bL and bLG are both true; the boundary group must exist. Use empty string when All is selected.
